## Question

What are we trying to figure out?

## Why this needs research

Why can't we just go build it? What's the unknown — feasibility, cost, integration shape, legal/ToS issue, etc.

## What I'll do

- [ ] Step 1
- [ ] Step 2

## Deliverable

What does "done" look like? Usually a short write-up in `docs/` or a comment on this issue with findings + a recommended next issue.

## Timebox

How long am I willing to spend before reporting back even if inconclusive? (e.g. "2 hours")
